quests.title: One side of the field
quests.ask: Plant a gem on the starting corner, then walk along the bottom edge to the next corner.
quests.nudge: This is one round of your loop. What has to happen at the corner before the next side?

quests.title: Round the corner and on
quests.ask: Keep going so the robot also goes up the right-hand side and plants a gem on the top-right corner.
quests.nudge: When does the turn happen: once at the very end, or at every corner?

quests.title: All the way home
quests.ask: Plant all four corners and finish back on the starting corner, facing east.
quests.nudge: Count the corners in the picture. How many rounds does that make?
